convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'SlopeDirectionLine' custom indicator and depends on two external .mqh includes (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh). The custom indicator's internal logic (double smoothing with JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA methods beyond standard MA types) and the trade management functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh require manual Python reimplementation.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total (warmup bars)
derived_values.formula: GetStartBars(MA_Method1, Length1, Phase1) + GetStartBars(MA_Method2, int(max(sqrt(Length1),1)), Phase2) + 2 + SignalBar

other_exits: Long closes when SlopeDirectionLine buffer1[1] == 0 (bearish trend state)
Short closes when SlopeDirectionLine buffer1[1] == 2 (bullish trend state)

params.description: MM fraction of deposit/balance/lot depending on MarginMode enum

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot, FREEMARGIN=% of free margin, BALANCE=% of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=% of loss-free margin, LOSSBALANCE=% of loss-balance

custom_logic_notes: The SlopeDirectionLine custom indicator returns discrete trend state values in buffer 1: 0=bearish, 1=neutral, 2=bullish. Entry triggers on a transition: long when Value[1]==2 AND Value[0]!=2 (trend just turned bullish on the signal bar), short when Value[1]==0 AND Value[0]!=0 (trend just turned bearish). The indicator uses extended smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which are not standard TA-Lib functions and must be manually reimplemented. The trade management functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory) come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and handle position checking, order sending, and margin calculation internally. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar (bar index 1), with Value[0] being bar 2 (one bar older) for transition detection.
python_conversion_notes: Three major reimplementations needed: (1) SlopeDirectionLine indicator - a double-smoothed trend indicator using LWMA(12, phase 15) then SMA(sqrt(12)≈3, phase 15) applied to CLOSE price, returning discrete states 0/1/2 for bear/neutral/bull. The custom smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) are non-standard and must be ported or approximated with standard MAs if exact replication is not required. (2) Trade management functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh - BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen with margin-based lot sizing (5 modes) and BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with position existence checks. (3) Entry logic uses buffer 1 of the indicator comparing Value[1] (signal bar) vs Value[0] (one bar before signal bar) to detect trend transitions. Fixed SL=1000 points, TP=2000 points. Signal evaluated on bar close (SignalBar=1), trades executed at next bar open for backtesting.
